items.title: Jayson Tatum on entering his 10th NBA season:
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Jayson Tatum on entering his 10th NBA season:

“It’s been a hell of a journey. And it definitely has flown by. I remember my first training camp in Newport…Remember it like it was yesterday.

“It’s hard to imagine that it’s already my 10th one. So, just try to stay present…Try to enjoy it.”
